visual_review: Rejected drawing: short hood-like hair cap, tiny face, narrow tall shoulders and an invented V collar with front opening, none of which are in the original.

Revision: long dome hair falling straight to y=26 on both sides, center-parted fringe peak, straight-sided face with circular jaw, one broad detached-hair shoulder arc touching the chin (avatar zero-gap rule).
Mirrored about x=24; reads as a long-haired woman bust at 48px in light and dark.
omissions: Outward flick of the hair ends (hair sides sit on the keyshape edge x=8)
Slight pointed chin of the reference (circular jaw rule)
